description: Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.

d.request: Average the season-to-date win counts over driver standings entries whose season-to-date points exceed 1.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1

c.request: Among driver standings entries where the driver has upwards of 1 point so far that season, what is the average season-to-date win count? Ignore missing values and don't round. Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1

b.request: Calculate the average of the season-to-date win counts (driverStandings.wins) for all driverStandings entries where the season-to-date points (driverStandings.points) are greater than 1.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1
b.raw: Calculate the average of the season-to-date win counts (driverStandings.wins) for all driverStandings entries where the season-to-date points (driverStandings.points) are greater than 1.

a.request: Across all driver standings entries where the driver's season-to-date points total is more than 1, what is the average season-to-date number of wins (ignoring missing values, unrounded)?
a.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1
